description.translate: Four lanterns for the sanctuary and courtyard. Let the next traveller see that someone is here. You owe me nothing beyond the help you choose to give. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The sanctuary can welcome people again. If your journey eventually carries you into the Nether, find Darius Emberwright at an abandoned Concord outpost. Tell him Ysra remembers the people who worked there. That road will open through your own progress; I cannot open it for you.
